study type: Planned secondary analysis of a large retrospective cohort study
exposure: Cesarean delivery in first stage of labor
Cesarean delivery in second stage of labor
outcome: Risk of spontaneous preterm birth (sPTB) in a subsequent pregnancy
cohort: Women with 2 consecutive deliveries from 2005-2010, excluding those with a previous sPTB
finding: Women who had a full-term second-stage cesarean delivery had a significantly higher risk of subsequent sPTB compared to those who had a vaginal delivery or a first-stage cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Women with a full-term second-stage cesarean delivery have a significantly higher than expected rate of subsequent sPTB (13.5%) compared with both the overall national sPTB rate (7-8%) and to a first-stage cesarean delivery (2.3%).
